metadata.title: {brand} – real estate in Serbia
metadata.description: Find apartments, houses, commercial spaces and land for sale and rent across Serbia.

home.title: Find your next home
home.subtitle: Apartments, houses and commercial spaces for sale and rent across Serbia — from private sellers and approved agents.

placeholder.title: Coming soon
placeholder.description: We're still building this part of the site. It will be available shortly.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

fields.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A longer phrase is safer than a short complex password.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Log in to manage your listings.
login.notVerified: Your email address isn't confirmed yet. Open the link we sent you or request a new one.
login.resent: If the account is awaiting confirmation, we've sent a new link to your email address.

register.title: Register
register.description: Create a private seller account and list your property.
register.checkEmailDescription: We've sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account. The link is valid for 24 hours.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.description: Click the button to confirm your email address and activate your account.
verifyEmail.success: Your email address is confirmed. Your account is active.
verifyEmail.missingToken: This confirmation link is incomplete. Open it directly from the email we sent you.
verifyEmail.requestNew: Request a new link from the login page.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account's email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for this address, we've sent a password reset link. The link is valid for 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account. You'll be signed out on all devices.
resetPassword.success: Your password has been changed. Log in with your new password.
resetPassword.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

setupAccount.title: Set up your account
setupAccount.description: Choose a password to activate your account.
setupAccount.success: Your account is active. Log in with the password you chose.
setupAccount.missingToken: This setup link is incomplete. Open it directly from the email you received.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your new email address
confirmEmail.description: Confirm the change to make this the email address you log in with.
confirmEmail.changed: Your email address has been changed. Use it the next time you log in.
confirmEmail.awaitingApproval: Your new email address is confirmed. It takes effect once our team approves your profile changes.
confirmEmail.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open it directly from the email you received.
confirmEmail.requestNew: Request a new link from your profile page.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.comingSoon: Inquiries, account settings and administration are coming soon.

listings.title: My listings
listings.description: Drafts, listings in review and published listings.
listings.emptyDescription: Create your first listing. Save it as a draft and send it for review when it's ready.
listings.loadFailed: Your listings can't be loaded right now.
listings.notFound: This listing doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

editor.submitConfirmDescription: While it's in review you can't edit or withdraw it. Our team will check it and email you the outcome.
editor.revised: The listing is a draft again. Make your changes and submit it again.
editor.deleteConfirmDescription: The draft will disappear from your list. This can't be undone.
editor.pendingNotice: This listing is in review and can't be changed until our team has checked it.
editor.rejectedNotice: This listing was rejected. Read the reason, turn the listing back into a draft, update it and submit it again.
editor.publishedNotice: This listing is published. Editing published listings is coming soon.
editor.readOnlyNotice: This listing can't be changed right now.
editor.requiredHint: Fields marked * are required before you can submit for review.

sections.descriptionHint: Serbian text is required. English is optional; without it, the English page shows the Serbian text.

fields.title: Title
fields.mapHint: Click the map, drag the marker, or use your current location if you're at the property.
fields.addressNotFound: Address not found. Place the marker yourself.
fields.locationDenied: Location access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings or place the marker yourself.
fields.locationUnavailable: Your location couldn't be determined. Place the marker yourself.
fields.floorHint: 0 is the ground floor; negative numbers are below ground.
fields.priceOnRequestHint: Visitors will see "Price on request" instead of an amount.

address.publicHint: When off, visitors only see the city, municipality and neighborhood.
address.confirmTitle: Show the exact address to everyone?
address.confirmDescription: The street, number and exact map location will be visible to every visitor. Only turn this on if you want the address to be public.

images.rules: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, 50 KB to 15 MB, at least 1024 × 768 pixels. At least {min}, at most {max} images.
images.moveHint: Drag images to change their order. The cover doesn't have to be first.
images.savedInstantly: Image changes are saved straight away, so you don't need to save the draft for them.
images.savedInstantlyPublished: Image changes are saved straight away. Added and removed images are sent for review; order and cover change immediately.
images.added: {count, plural, one {# image added.} other {# images added.}}
images.removalProposed: The image will be removed once your changes are approved.

checklist.title: Ready for review
checklist.ready: This listing has everything needed for review.
checklist.floorAboveTotal: the floor can't be above the total number of floors

published.notice: This listing is published. Price, address visibility and image order change immediately. Other changes are sent for review; the published version stays as it is until they're approved.
published.sentForReview: Saved. Your changes were sent for review.
published.revisionPending: Changes are waiting for review. The published version stays as it is until they're approved; you can keep editing until then.
published.revisionRejected: Your last changes were not approved. The published version stayed as it was.
published.coverMustBeApproved: Only an approved image can be the cover.

listingsReview.title: Listings
listingsReview.description: Review submissions and manage every listing on the platform.
listingsReview.creator: Advertiser

review.title: Review
review.pendingNotice: This listing is waiting for review. Check the content and images, then approve it or reject it with a reason.
review.approveDescription: It will be visible to everyone, and the advertiser will be notified by email.
review.rejectDescription: The advertiser sees the reason in their dashboard and receives it by email.
review.statusDescription: The listing will no longer be public. This can't be undone.
review.searchAgents: Search agents by name or email
review.permanentDeleteDescription: The listing, its images and its history are deleted for good; only the audit log keeps a record. This can't be undone.

revision.title: Changes to review
revision.description: The advertiser changed this published listing. Approve to publish the changes, or reject them with a reason; the published version stays as it is.
revision.imagesAdded: {count, plural, one {# new image} other {# new images}}
revision.imagesRemoved: {count, plural, one {# image to remove} other {# images to remove}}
revision.approveDescription: The changes become public right away, and the advertiser will be notified by email.
revision.rejectDescription: The published version stays as it is. The advertiser sees the reason and receives it by email.

users.title: Users
users.description: Private seller, agent and administrator accounts.
users.deactivateDescription: The user is signed out and can't sign in, and their listings are hidden until the account is reactivated. They'll receive the reason by email.
users.reactivateDescription: The user can sign in again and their published listings become visible again. They'll receive your note by email.
users.inviteDescription: We'll email them a link to set their password (valid for 7 days).

agentApplication.title: Agent application
agentApplication.private: The proof files are kept as evidence of eligibility and are visible to administrators only.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Important actions on the platform, newest first.

validation.tooShort: Enter at least {min, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
validation.tooLong: Enter at most {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check the details you entered.
errors.INVALID_JSON: The request was malformed. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The data you sent is too large.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email address or password is incorrect.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please confirm your email address before logging in.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You're not allowed to do this.
errors.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: The request was blocked for security reasons. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This action isn't possible right now.
errors.SUBMISSION_INCOMPLETE: The listing is missing information required for review.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: The image doesn't meet the requirements.
errors.IMAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: The listing already has the maximum number of images.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.EXTERNAL_SERVICE_FAILED: An external service is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_FILE: A file doesn't meet the requirements.
errors.EMAIL_IN_USE: This email address already belongs to an account.

agentApplication.title: Advertise as a real-estate agent
agentApplication.intro: Agents publish listings under their own agent profile. Tell us about yourself and send proof that you work as an agent; our team reviews every application before an agent account is created.

steps.apply: Send your details and proof, such as a licence or an employment confirmation from your agency.
steps.review: Our team checks your application and emails you the outcome.
steps.setup: Once approved, you set your password from the email and can start publishing listings.

agentApplication.sellerNote: Selling your own property? You don't need an agent account.

fields.emailHint: Your agent account will use this address. It can't already belong to a Walls account.
fields.phoneHint: Shown on your public agent profile.

agentApplication.filesHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to {maxMb} MB each, at most {max} files. Only our team can see them.
agentApplication.tooManyFiles: You can send at most {max} files.
agentApplication.fileWrongType: {name} isn't a PDF, JPG or PNG file.

fileIssues.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: not a PDF, JPG or PNG file

agentApplication.successDescription: We've sent a confirmation to {email}. You'll hear from us by email once our team has reviewed your application.

agentApplications.title: Agent applications
agentApplications.description: Check each applicant's details and proof before approving an agent account.
agentApplications.emailInUse: This email address now belongs to an existing account, so the application can't be approved. Reject it and ask the applicant to apply with another address.
agentApplications.approveDescription: An agent account is created from these details and the applicant receives an email to set their password.
agentApplications.approved: Application approved. The applicant has been emailed.
agentApplications.rejectDescription: The applicant receives the reason by email. No account is created.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: What visitors see on your public profile page.
profile.approvalNotice: Changes to your agent profile are checked by our team before they become public.
profile.pendingNotice: Your changes are waiting for review. Your public profile stays as it is until they're approved; you can keep editing until then.
profile.rejectedNotice: Your last changes were not approved. Reason:
profile.showingProposed: The form shows your changes waiting for review.

fields.bioHint: A few sentences for your profile page.
fields.phonePublic: Show my phone number on my profile
fields.phoneAlwaysPublic: Agents' phone numbers are always shown on their profile.
fields.emailPublic: Show my email address on my profile

profile.phoneStatusHint: Phone numbers are shown as not verified; you can't verify them yourself.
profile.sentForReview: Your changes were sent for review.
profile.unchanged: There are no changes to save.
profile.discardDescription: Your public profile stays as it is.

avatar.rules: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, at least 200 × 200 pixels, up to 10 MB.

email.pendingHint: Open the link we sent to the new address to confirm it.
email.sent: We've sent a confirmation link to {email}.
email.agentNote: After you confirm the new address, the change also needs our team's approval.

profileChanges.title: Profile changes
profileChanges.description: Agents' profile changes become public only after approval.
profileChanges.approveDescription: The agent's public profile is updated and they're notified by email.
profileChanges.rejectDescription: The public profile stays as it is. The agent receives the reason by email.

publicProfile.agentsDescription: Agents approved by Walls and the properties they advertise.
publicProfile.listingCount: {count, plural, =0 {No listings} one {# listing} other {# listings}}
publicProfile.approvedAgentHint: Walls checked this agent's professional details.
publicProfile.phoneUnverifiedHint: Walls hasn't verified this phone number.
publicProfile.noListings: No published listings at the moment.
